moe_note: moe: the generic MoE Op (ops/moe) per exact layer; "prefill" serves every call of 17 tokens or more under the prefill profile, chosen from ninferno_moe_bench --plans sweep --prefill as the token-invariant plan with the lowest geometric mean of time over the best plan at T = 17..2048; evidence_us rows are [T, default plan us, this plan us], median of the bench. Decode keeps the default plans (within 0-7 %). "bands" [1, 1]: the fastest plan of ninferno_moe_bench --plans sweep at T = 1, kept where ninferno-dense decode gains; evidence_decode_us rows are [T, default plan us, this plan us]. The gpt-oss MXFP4 layer's prefill plan (rmma, measured before the grouped W4A8 existed) is gone: as a token-invariant table plan it kept the experts on the register MMA; the heuristic's grouped W4A8 prefills 1K/4K/16K at chunk 1024 in 25.3K/24.4K/20.8K tok/s against 21.2K/20.5K/17.8K (+17..19 %), at chunk 4096 +20..25 %, decode equal (RTX 5090, A B B A).
